units.locator: Article 23.74. Bank of Russia
units.text: 1. The Bank of Russia shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.53 - 5.55, parts 10 and 14 of Article 7.30.3, parts 1 and 3 of Article 13.11.3 (within its powers), parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 13.25, parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 14.4.1, parts 1 - 5 and 7 - 9 of Article 14.24, Articles 14.29 and 14.30, parts 1 - 3 of Article 14.52 (where those offences are committed by self-regulatory organisations in the financial market), Articles 14.52.2 and 15.17 - 15.22, parts 1 - 10 of Article 15.23.1, Article 15.24.1, parts 2 - 4 and 6 of Article 15.26.1, part 1 of Article 15.26.2 (except restrictions on operating hours), Articles 15.26.3 - 15.26.5, parts 1 - 3 of Article 15.27 (within its powers), Articles 15.28 - 15.31, 15.34.1, 15.35 and 15.38, parts 1, 3 and 5 of Article 15.39, Article 15.48 (within its powers), parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7.3 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.74

units.locator: Article 23.74. Bank of Russia
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the Bank of Russia:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.74

units.locator: Article 23.74. Bank of Russia
units.text: 1) the Chairperson of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, his or her deputies, the head of a territorial institution of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.74

units.locator: Article 23.74. Bank of Russia
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation and their deputies whose competence includes matters of supervision and control in financial markets (except banking activities) — concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.53 - 5.55, parts 1 and 3 of Article 13.11.3 (within their powers), parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 13.25, parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 14.4.1, parts 1 - 5 and 7 - 9 of Article 14.24, Articles 14.29 and 14.30, parts 1 - 3 of Article 14.52 (where those offences are committed by self-regulatory organisations in the financial market), Articles 14.52.2 and 15.17 - 15.22, parts 1 - 10 of Article 15.23.1, Article 15.24.1, parts 2 - 4 and 6 of Article 15.26.1, part 1 of Article 15.26.2 (except restrictions on operating hours), Articles 15.26.3 - 15.26.5, parts 1 - 3 of Article 15.27 (except administrative offences committed by credit institutions, officials of credit institutions and employees of credit institutions specified in note 2 to Article 15.27), Articles 15.28 - 15.31, 15.34.1, 15.35 and 15.38, Article 15.48 (within their powers), parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7.3 of this Code;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.74

units.locator: Article 23.74. Bank of Russia
units.text: 3) repealed. — Federal Law of 23.06.2020 No. 187-FZ.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.74

units.locator: Article 23.76. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Destruction of Chemical Weapons
units.text: 1. Federal executive authorities exercising state supervision in the field of destruction of chemical weapons shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 9.20 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.76

units.locator: Article 23.76. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Destruction of Chemical Weapons
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:

units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.76

units.locator: Article 23.76. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Destruction of Chemical Weapons
units.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities exercising state supervision in the field of destruction of chemical weapons and their deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.76

units.locator: Article 23.77. Military Motor Vehicle Inspectorate
units.text: Article 23.77. Military Motor Vehicle Inspectorate
units.label: Art. 23.77

units.locator: Article 23.77. Military Motor Vehicle Inspectorate
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.77. Military Motor Vehicle Inspectorate
units.label: Art. 23.77

units.locator: Article 23.77. Military Motor Vehicle Inspectorate
units.text: 1. Officials of the military motor vehicle inspectorate shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.22, 8.23 and 12.1, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.2, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.3, part 3 of Article 12.4 (except cases of unlawful application of a passenger taxi colour and graphic scheme), parts 1, 1.1 and 2 of Article 12.5, Article 12.6, parts 1 and 3 of Article 12.7, Article 12.12 (except cases of proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or failure to comply with the Road Traffic Rules requirement to stop before a stop line indicated by road signs or road surface markings when the traffic light signal prohibits movement), Article 12.21, Article 12.21.1 (except cases where an administrative offence is recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions, or by photographic, cinematographic or video-recording equipment), Article 12.21.2, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.23, part 3 of Article 12.25, Articles 12.31, 12.32 and 12.37, and Article 19.22 (with respect to the registration of motor vehicles with an engine displacement exceeding fifty cubic centimetres and a maximum design speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour, and trailers for them, intended for use on public roads) of this Code in relation to an official of a military unit responsible for the technical condition and operation of vehicles and the driver of a vehicle of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, or rescue military formations of the federal executive authority authorised to perform tasks in the field of civil defence.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.77

units.locator: Article 23.77. Military Motor Vehicle Inspectorate
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the military motor vehicle inspectorate in relation to an official of a military unit responsible for the technical condition and operation of vehicles and the driver of a vehicle of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, or rescue military formations of the federal executive authority authorised to perform tasks in the field of civil defence:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.77

units.locator: Article 23.77. Military Motor Vehicle Inspectorate
units.text: 1) the head of the Military Motor Vehicle Inspectorate of the Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation, his or her deputy, the head of the military motor vehicle inspectorate (regional), his or her deputy, the head of the military motor vehicle inspectorate (territorial), his or her deputy, the head of the military motor vehicle inspectorate of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, his or her deputy, the head of the military motor vehicle inspectorate of an operational-territorial large formation (formation) of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, his or her deputy, the head of the military motor vehicle inspectorate of the federal executive authority authorised to perform tasks in the field of civil defence and his or her deputy — concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.22, 8.23 and 12.1, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.2, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.3, part 3 of Article 12.4 (except cases of unlawful application of a passenger taxi colour and graphic scheme), parts 1, 1.1 and 2 of Article 12.5, Article 12.6, parts 1 and 3 of Article 12.7, Article 12.12 (except cases of proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or failure to comply with the Road Traffic Rules requirement to stop before a stop line indicated by road signs or road surface markings when the traffic light signal prohibits movement), Article 12.21, Article 12.21.1 (except cases where an administrative offence is recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions, or by photographic, cinematographic or video-recording equipment), Article 12.21.2, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.23, part 3 of Article 12.25, Articles 12.31, 12.32 and 12.37, and Article 19.22 (with respect to the registration of motor vehicles with an engine displacement exceeding fifty cubic centimetres and a maximum design speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour, and trailers for them, intended for use on public roads) of this Code;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.77

units.locator: Article 23.77. Military Motor Vehicle Inspectorate
units.text: 2) the head of a department (division, group, laboratory), his or her deputy, a senior assistant (assistant) to the head of a division, a chief inspector, a senior officer, a senior inspector (inspector), a senior inspector (inspector) of the road patrol service, a senior instructor, or a senior technician (technician) of the military motor vehicle inspectorate — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 12.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.2, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.3, parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 12.5, Article 12.6, Article 12.12 (except cases of proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or failure to comply with the Road Traffic Rules requirement to stop before a stop line indicated by road signs or road surface markings when the traffic light signal prohibits movement), Article 12.21, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.23, part 3 of Article 12.25, Articles 12.31 and 12.32, part 1 of Article 12.37, and Article 19.22 (with respect to the registration of motor vehicles with an engine displacement exceeding fifty cubic centimetres and a maximum design speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour, and trailers for them, intended for use on public roads) of this Code.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.77

units.locator: Article 23.78. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Control Functions over Foreign Investment in the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 23.78. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Control Functions over Foreign Investment in the Russian Federation

units.locator: Article 23.78. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Control Functions over Foreign Investment in the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.78. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Control Functions over Foreign Investment in the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 23.78

units.locator: Article 23.78. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Control Functions over Foreign Investment in the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised to perform control functions over foreign investment in the Russian Federation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 19.8.2 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.78

units.locator: Article 23.78. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Control Functions over Foreign Investment in the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The head of the federal executive authority authorised to perform control functions over foreign investment in the Russian Federation and his or her deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.78

units.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast
units.text: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast
units.label: Art. 23.79

units.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast
units.label: Art. 23.79

units.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast
units.text: 1. Executive authorities of the constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are the cities of federal significance Moscow and Saint Petersburg shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 5 of Article 12.16 of this Code where the transfer of those powers is provided for by agreements between federal executive authorities and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on the transfer of the exercise of part of their powers.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.79

units.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast
units.text: 1.1. Executive authorities of the city of federal significance Sevastopol and of Moscow Oblast shall hear cases concerning administrative offences committed in the territories of the city of federal significance Sevastopol and Moscow Oblast and provided for by part 4 of Article 12.16 of this Code where the transfer of those powers is provided for by agreements between the federal executive authority and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on the transfer of the exercise of part of their powers, and officials of executive authorities of the city of federal significance Sevastopol and of Moscow Oblast directly discover indications of administrative offences.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 23.79

units.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast
units.text: 2. Heads and deputy heads of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.79

units.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast
units.text: 3. Executive authorities of the constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are the cities of federal significance Moscow, Saint Petersburg and Sevastopol exercising the powers provided for by Article 19 of Federal Law of 13 March 2006 No. 38-FZ 'On Advertising' shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.37 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23.79

units.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast
units.text: 4. Officials of the respective authorities who are included in lists approved by regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 3 of this Article.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 23.79

units.locator: Article 23.79.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 23.79.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 23.79.2

units.locator: Article 23.79.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.79.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 23.79.2

units.locator: Article 23.79.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. In addition to the cases provided for by this Chapter, executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by this Code and committed in their territories where this is provided for by regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation on the transfer of powers of federal executive authorities for exercise by executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, adopted in accordance with federal laws, or by agreements concluded in accordance with federal law between federal executive authorities and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on the transfer of the exercise of part of their powers, except powers to hear cases concerning administrative offences in the field of road traffic provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.79.2

units.locator: Article 23.79.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. Heads of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, their deputies, heads of structural divisions of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.79.2

units.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations

units.label: Art. 23.80

units.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations
units.label: Art. 23.80

units.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations
units.text: 1. Federal executive authorities authorised to exercise state supervision over the activities of self-regulatory organisations shall, within their powers, hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.52 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.80

units.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.80

units.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations
units.text: 1) heads of federal executive authorities authorised to exercise state supervision over the activities of self-regulatory organisations and their deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.80

units.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of those authorities and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.80

units.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of those authorities and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.80

units.locator: Article 23.81. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in Healthcare
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in healthcare and its territorial authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.28, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 6.29, Articles 6.30 and 6.32, part 2 of Article 6.34, Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of facilities of organisations carrying out medical and pharmaceutical activities and the services they provide), Article 14.4.2 (except the circulation of medicinal products for veterinary use), parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 and 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, Article 18.21, part 5 of Article 19.4, part 21 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7.8 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.81
